description: This file defines the PatientIdentifier class, which models patient identifiers such as medical record numbers, social security numbers, etc., in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes fields for identifier, identifier type, location, patient, and associated programs, along with relevant methods, annotations for search indexing, auditing, and serialization.

classes.name: PatientIdentifier
classes.description: Represents an identifier associated with a patient, including details like identifier string, type, location, whether it's preferred, and related patient program info. Implements comparison, cloning, and equality methods, with annotations for Hibernate Search and auditing.

methods.name: equalsContent
methods.description: Compares the core fields of this PatientIdentifier with another to assess content equality, considering identifier, type, and location.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of this PatientIdentifier object without copying the associated Patient object.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Comparator class that defines ordering for PatientIdentifier objects based on voided status, preference, creation date, identifier type, and identifier string.
